profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Waymo

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer / Technical Lead Manager (TLM)
positions.description: Lead for a variety of areas across the Mapping team spanning both infrastructure and algorithms. Particular areas include Field Response Infrastructure, Mapping Change Detection, Localization, and Imagery/SLAM.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer / Technical Lead Manager (TLM)
Senior Software Engineer - Data
positions.description: Designed and built data processing at scale for product features, machine learning models, A/B experimentation, and offline analytics.

positions.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
positions.description: Protected the security of the Netflix service through large scale data analytics and engineering.

positions.title: Graduate Student Researcher & Assistant Instructor
positions.description:
• Conducted research in 4-dimensional topology, produced two published papers and delivered invited talks at national conferences and many seminars. 
• Recognized through a departmental teaching award and three teaching promotions culminating in the highest position available to graduate students, including roles managing teaching initiatives and supervising peers.
